pretreatment: The Ru substrate was used as the bottom electrode and was oxidized by O3 during the previous ALD step of the TiO2 subcycle. The oxidized Ru layer acted as an oxygen reservoir, which induced a chemical vapor deposition (CVD)-like reaction during the Sr(iPr3Cp)2 precursor injection step.
surface_functionalization: The oxidized Ru layer was partially reduced during the Ti(CpMe5)(OMe)3 pulse step, which rarely occurred with Ti-(O-iPr)2(tmhd)2. Moreover, the possibility of out-diﬀusion of the oxygen became lower due to the higher growth rate of the TiO2 subcycle.
